_comment: Each platform is reachable two ways, with very different standing:
directoryHosts  a Web Bot Auth key directory. A signature that verifies
against a key published here PROVES the agent's identity.
key             the button on /agents. Clicking it CLAIMS an identity.
`trusted: true` only ever applies to the proven path. A button click lands
on the 'declared' tier no matter which platform it names, so nobody can
click their way to a spending cap.
descopeClientIdEnv names the environment variable holding the Descope
Inbound App client for this platform — the client is what carries the
agent's identity into a Descope policy. The IDs themselves are not
committed; they are project configuration, not source.
